summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) issuance by BANK5 2026-5YR24, a Delaware statutory trust. Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., as depositor, issued 28 publicly offered and 10 privately offered certificate classes backed by 35 commercial, multifamily, and manufactured housing community mortgage loans. The certificates were sold to underwriters including Morgan Stanley, BofA Securities, Wells Fargo, and J.P. Morgan under an underwriting agreement dated August 2026. This is a routine securitization transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing merely documents the issuance of asset-backed securities pursuant to a pooling and servicing agreement.
